walkthroughs.title: Welcome to Spin Your AI
walkthroughs.description: Set up your AI providers, local models, MCP servers, and start spinning!

steps.title: 1. Local AI (Ollama)
steps.description:
Spin Your AI connects to your local Ollama instance on localhost:11434 out of the box. No keys required!
[Configure Ollama Endpoint](command:spin-your-ai.configureOllama)

steps.title: 2. Cloud AI API Keys
steps.description:
Want to use GPT-4o, Claude 3.5, or Gemini 1.5? Configure your API keys securely in your OS keychain.
[Set OpenAI Key](command:spin-your-ai.setOpenAiKey)
[Set Anthropic Key](command:spin-your-ai.setAnthropicKey)
[Set Gemini Key](command:spin-your-ai.setGeminiKey)
[Set OpenRouter Key](command:spin-your-ai.setOpenRouterKey)
[Set Hugging Face Key](command:spin-your-ai.setHuggingFaceKey)
[Set Ollama Cloud Key](command:spin-your-ai.setOllamaCloudKey)

steps.title: 3. MCP & Local Agents
steps.description:
Connect to Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool servers (like n8n-mcp) and autonomous agents like Hermes, OpenCode, and OpenClaw.
[Edit MCP Configuration](command:spin-your-ai.editMcpConfig)
[Open Settings](command:spin-your-ai.openSettings)
[Configure Hermes Endpoint](command:spin-your-ai.configureHermes)
[Configure OpenCode Endpoint](command:spin-your-ai.configureOpenCode)
[Configure OpenClaw Endpoint](command:spin-your-ai.configureOpenClaw)
